title: Workflow
description: A campaign workflow: a DAG of steps joined by edges. The one source of truth for workflow shape; the web app's TypeScript types are generated from it.

StepKind.description: What a step does: call an agent, render an asset, wait for a human, publish, or wait a while.

StepId.description: Lower-case letters, digits, and underscores, starting with a letter.

RetryPolicy.description: How a failing step is retried before it stops the run.

maximum_attempts.description: How many times the step runs before it gives up, the first attempt included.

initial_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait before the first retry; each later wait doubles.

duration_seconds.description: How long a wait step waits. Only wait steps have it, and they must.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one attempt of the step may run before it counts as failed.

WorkflowEdge.description: The step `to` starts only after the step `from` has succeeded.
